newsitem.title: USA: Pete's Brewing names Atkins CEO.
newsitem.headline: Pete's Brewing names Atkins CEO.

text.p: Pete's Brewing Co said Monday it had elected Jeffrey Atkins, its chief financial officer and acting chief operating officer, as chief executive officer.
Atkins was elected acting COO in addition to his CFO responsibilities in February with the announced retirement of Mark Bozzini as president and CEO.

"We believe, as do many of our competitors and knowledgeable industry experts, that 1997 is the beginning of a consolidation period, an evolutionary process for the craft beer category," said Pete's Chairman Philip Marineau. "The board of directors, Jeff Atkins and the management team are committed to profitably grow Pete's. Our goal is to leverage our strong financial and market position and to focus on strengthening competitive capabilities, including a unique brand equity, a national distribution network built on a philosophy of partnership, and a long-term source of supply based on low-cost production and investment through our brewing alliance with the Stroh Brewery Co."
